content: Based on the context provided, an O'Reilly license for an Engineering team member will stay active for **3 months**. After this period, access is removed to reallocate seats and licenses to other users.

messages.content:
Use the following context to answer the question.

Context:
[Self-Paced External Trainings > O'Reilly Learning > How to get an O'Reilly license]
O'Reilly is funded by Engineering, so is currently only available for Engineering team members please request access via [Lumos](/handbook/security/corporate/systems/lumos/ar/). Please note, seats are very limited, so you may need to wait until one becomes available.

To ensure seats and licenses are used effectively, access will be removed after 3 months to reallocate seats/licenses to other users. If you would like access again in the future, you can re-request it.

If you're outside of Engineering and would like an O'Reilly license, you can purchase one using the [G&D Fund](/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/).

[Self-Paced External Trainings > O'Reilly Learning > How to get an O'Reilly license > Accessing O'Reilly content]
Once you have an active license, we have a content integration set up in [LevelUp](https://levelup.edcast.com/), so you can find and filter O'Reilly content using the search function, alongside all our other self-paced learning materials.

You can also access via the [O'Reilly platform](https://www.oreilly.com/online-learning/) directly.

[GitLab Offboarding FAQ > Timing > USA > Where can I find my pay stubs?]
Former team members will retain access to ADP for three years after they leave so they can access pay stubs and W-2s. Former team members will need to access ADP portal directly since Okta has been deprovisioned. If you experience login issues, please send an e-mail to uspayroll@gitlab.com so the team can assist.

Question: How long will an O'Reilly license stay active before it is automatically revoked for an Engineering team member?
